      "descriptions": [
        {
          "description": "This artifact provides the full MATLAB implementation and experimental pipeline for the anchor-interpolated privacy optimization (AIPO) framework, which enforces ℓp-norm Metric Differential Privacy (mDP) on continuous or fine-grained domains. It includes the following components:\n\nExperiment driver scripts (main_2norm.m, main_1norm.m, main_granularity.m, main_ablation_privacybudget.m): Each script reproduces a specific subset of tables/figures in the paper and writes outputs to the ./results/ subdirectories (e.g., cost/, violation/, time/, ppr/). Specifically:\n\n\n\nmain_2norm.m produces Tables 2–4 and Figures 8–10 (Appendix);\n\nmain_1norm_appendix.m produces Tables 8–10 (Appendix);\n\nmain_granularity_appendix.m produces Figure 14 (Appendix); and\n\nmain_privacyablation_budget.m produces Table 7 and Figures 11–13 (Appendix).\n\n\nCore implementation and helper functions (./functions/): This directory contains the optimization, interpolation, and evaluation routines implementing AIPO, as well as baseline methods (Exponential Mechanism, Laplace, TEM, COPT, LP, etc.).\n\nDatasets (./datasets/): This directory contains the processed OpenStreetMap road-network datasets (nodes and edges) for Rome, London, and New York City used in all experiments.\n\nIntermediate and result artifacts (./intermediate/, ./results/): ./intermediate/ caches reusable intermediate artifacts to avoid recomputation, while ./results/ stores the final metrics (utility loss, mDP violation ratio, runtime, PPR) for each mechanism and city.",
          "descriptionType": "Abstract"
        }
